why: The hidden things in the two apps, written once so the phones agree on the counts and the words. Seven taps on the build line under You shows a line; pulling the session list to refresh four times inside a minute shows another. EggsTests.swift and EggsTest.kt run every case.
line: Seven taps unlocks developer options on a phone. This app has no hidden settings, only this line.

pulls.line: Pulling again does not make a host report sooner. Each one reports on its own, whether or not anybody is pulling.
